annotations.title: EVE Frontier Multi-System SSU Commodity Arbitrage Route Finder

description: Scans Smart Storage Unit (SSU) bid/ask spreads across star systems against ship cargo capacity and stargate fuel costs to rank net-profitable arbitrage loops. Use when planning multi-system trade runs to maximize net LUX profit per gigajoule of fuel burned; for calculating internal bid/ask market-maker quotes for your own SSU, use quote_eve_ssu_market instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'origin_system' ('hull_cargo_class' defaults to 'light_courier'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

hull_cargo_class.description: Trade vessel hull class determining cargo volume and fuel mass; defaults to 'medium_hauler' when omitted.

origin_system.description: Starting solar system for the trade vessel (e.g. 'System-Alpha').

name: find_eve_ssu_arbitrage

best_commodity.description: Highest-margin commodity identified across reachable SSUs.

buy_ssu_system.description: Solar system where the commodity should be purchased.

net_profit_lux_after_tolls.description: Net LUX profit after deducting gate tolls and fuel replacement cost.

sell_ssu_system.description: Solar system where the commodity should be sold.

title: EVE Frontier Multi-System SSU Commodity Arbitrage Route Finder
